core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Code aesthetic with Swiss precision
Content is King: Data is the hero
Negative Space: Value empty areas for focus
Contrast: High contrast for readability in dark mode

rules: Headings MUST use 'Azeret Mono' for a technical feel.
Body text uses 'Inter' for maximum legibility.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all data values, confidence scores, and code blocks.
Uppercase labels with wide tracking (tracking-widest) for section headers.

usage.primary: Used for 'Fast/Simple' routing signals and primary actions.
usage.secondary: Used for 'Complex/GPT-4' routing signals and advanced features.
usage.accent: Used for latency warnings and attention grabbers.
usage.background: Deepest black for the main app background.
usage.surface: Slightly lighter black for cards and containers.

rules: Use 'grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12' for the main dashboard.
Metrics Row: 4 columns of equal width for key stats.

cards.classes: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-[#1F1F1F] rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors duration-300
cards.special_variant: Tracing Beam - Use for active routing result card.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-md font-medium px-6 py-2 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(16,185,129,0.2)]
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-white hover:bg-secondary/90 rounded-md font-medium px-6 py-2

inputs.classes: bg-black border-border focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary text-white placeholder:text-gray-600 font-mono

visual_enhancers.scanlines: Optional: subtle scanline overlay for 'Terminal' sections.

rules: All interactive elements MUST have a hover state transition.
Routing result should animate in (fade + slide up).

hero_background.description: Abstract neural network smoke on black background. Use as subtle background with low opacity (10-20%) overlay.

server_texture.description: Server rack lights. Use for 'Infrastructure' or 'Model Status' section headers.

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
Dark Mode is mandatory. Ensure text contrast is high (WCAG AA).
Do not use gradients for text, only for borders or backgrounds.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the dashboard using the defined color palette and typography. Focus on the 'Routing Interface' as the hero element. Use the 'Bento Grid' layout for the analytics section. Ensure the 'MiniLM' and 'GPT-4' routing logic is visualized clearly with the color coding (Green for Simple, Purple for Complex).
